Image 2 is ONLY a drawing-style reference: refined controlled dark ink linework, subtle line weight, restrained cel color blocks, soft illustrated volume and fine faint paper texture. Do not copy bull identity horns or clothes from image 2. Preserve the original species and existing degree of anthropomorphism, not a redesign. Landscape 3:2 sheet: left full front, center full side, right full back, same scale and baseline, ample margins including full antennae/antlers/wing tips/feet. Warm pale beige paper backdrop with subtle drawn contact shadow. Crisp detailed line-art drawn fur/feathers and fabric folds, clearly non-photoreal and non-3D. No labels text watermark panels scenery extra people. Red-brown ant city sanitation worker, bent antennae and rounded abdomen, orange reflective jacket, dark trousers boots, pale gloves, waist litter grabber and refuse roll. EXACTLY TWO ARMS TWO HANDS TWO LEGS. No additional limbs, no extra sleeves.
